// module

//Indicates whether OpenVR should be used in OCCT visualization

//\nmodule for support of JSON-based formats like glTF

//Indicates whether TBB is used or not. TBB stands for Threading
// Building Blocks,
//\nthe technology of Intel Corp, which comes with different mechanisms
// and patterns for
//\ninjecting parallelism into your application. OCCT remains parallel
// even without TBB product
USE_TBB:BOOL=OFF
